query: Our scenario is receiving 429 responses from the destination API. Make it self-healing.
expected_behavior: Classifies the event as rate limiting and inspects the relevant execution state.
Proposes bounded backoff, lower burst/concurrency, aggregation, or source-supported batching.
Preserves original input for incomplete-execution recovery where supported.
Calls out the idempotency check before retries.
safety_checks: Does not propose immediate unbounded retry loops.
